findings.reason: as written the node cannot state that the control must fire, so §8's only negative control may pass on a correct run and the section's claim "so that §7 measures drift and not wiring" goes unguarded.
findings.text: §8 clause (3) builds its control by scaling "every magnetics row and the conductor currents" by 1.10, but the measured plasma current is a separate input in this plan's own vocabulary (§1 lists "flux-loop, field-probe and plasma-current rows"; §2's clause (3) scales "every magnetics row, the measured plasma current, and the measured conductor currents"), and imas-efit enters the total-Ip measurement as its own single least-squares row against ~1176 flux-loop/probe rows (imas-efit `configuration/machines/ITER/machine.xml`, the `plasmaCurrent` block), so the unscaled Ip row keeps pulling the reconstruction's plasma current back toward the generating value and whether the control fires becomes an accident of the relative group weights rather than a property of the pipeline

findings.reason: without bands on the axis, flux and q95 the section cannot show that its wiring is unbiased on the very axes §7 measures, which is the reason the section was split out of §7.
findings.text: §8 clause (2) tabulates magnetic axis position, boundary flux and axis flux (as a fraction of the span) and q95 against the generating state with no tolerance, and the only band in the section — plasma current within 1.5 % — is also exactly the quantity clause (3)'s control targets, so the section's comparison cannot fail on any of the quantities §7 later reports as drift measures; a wiring bias of a few tenths of a metre in the axis would pass §8 and then be read in §7 as drift

response_events.note: The control in the section that runs imas-efit on nova rows now scales the measured plasma current together with every magnetics row and the conductor currents, so no unscaled row pulls the reconstruction back.

The same section's comparison now carries bands on every quantity the drifting-sensor section later reports: axis position within 0.02 m, boundary and axis flux within 2 percent of the span and q95 within 0.1, beside the plasma current band.
